info.title: Goo DevTools CLI
info.description: Local developer tooling for Goo applications.

commands.name: attach
commands.description: Attach to a live Goo endpoint and stream protocol events.

options.name: --project
options.description: Project file or directory.

options.name: --pid
options.description: Select one process ID.

options.name: --pipe
options.description: Select one pipe or socket endpoint.

options.name: --app
options.description: Select by application name.

options.name: --window
options.description: Select by stable window ID or window title.

options.name: --latest
options.description: Select the newest endpoint.

options.name: --wait
options.description: Wait for a descriptor, up to 300 seconds.

options.name: --inspector
options.description: Launch the standalone inspector when ready.

options.name: --input
options.description: Permit agent input in the app launched by dev.

options.name: --gesture
options.description: Continue or release a held pointer/key gesture.

options.name: --focus
options.description: Launch or focus the standalone inspector.

options.name: --json
options.description:
Keep protocol output as JSON lines.
JSON errors include code, phase, and mayHaveApplied fields.
Environment:
GOO_DEVTOOLS_DIR         Runtime descriptor directory override.
GOO_DEVTOOLS_INSPECTOR   Standalone inspector executable or DLL.
GOO_DEVTOOLS_INPUT=1     Permit application input when GOO_DEVTOOLS=1 enables diagnostics.

commands.name: capture
commands.description: Request a screenshot from an attached endpoint.

commands.name: dev
commands.description: Start a Goo project with diagnostics enabled and dotnet watch by default.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check the SDK, project, endpoint directory, and inspector installation.

commands.name: input
commands.description: Send an opted-in pointer, wheel, key, text, click, or reset event.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List live endpoints without connecting or selecting a window.
